event.name: Nepal Floods 2026
event.summary: On 26 August 2026 a glacier and rock collapse on the Tibetan side of the border sent a debris flow down the Lhende Khola into the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers. Coordinated mapping is led by HOT's Open Mapping Hub Asia-Pacific with NAXA and NDRRMA.
